retrievalProfile.description: A rustic, sepia-toned western layout featuring a central framed portrait surrounded by leather-textured backgrounds and engraved, spurred typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and denim jacket, framed by a thick rope border and set against a heavily textured, dark brown leather-like background. The composition is anchored by large, spurred serif lettering at the top and a curved banner with secondary text at the bottom, all encased in a thin double-line border.
coreVisualRelationships: The rope frame creates a window effect for the central subject.
The textured background provides a tactile, weathered foundation for the clean graphic elements.
The spurred typography mirrors the sharp angles of the cowboy hat.
The sepia color palette unifies the photography and graphic overlays into a vintage whole.
coreInvariants: Sepia or warm brown monochromatic color grading
Heavy leather or suede texture on the outer margins

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered and medium-shot, filling the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, spurred display text at the top acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the top display text, moves down to the central portrait, and settles on the bottom banner text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The outer margins are filled with a dark, textured 'leather' space that focuses attention on the central frame.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm cream and light tan (typography and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high contrast between dark shadows and warm, glowing highlights.
paletteRestrictions: No primary blues, greens, or purples

letterConstructionRules: Vertical spurs added to the midpoints of stems
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'J' has a deep, hooked descender
The 'R' features a curved leg with a sharp spur
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly decorative spurred display font paired with a simpler, arched slab serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the classic spurred Western aesthetic.
Provides the sturdy slab-serif foundation for the banner text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned portrait of a man in a cowboy hat and denim jacket, centered within a square frame. Surround the portrait with a thick rope border. The outer background should be a dark, textured brown suede or leather. Add a thin double-line border around the entire square.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place large, cream-colored spurred serif text at the top. At the bottom, place a weathered tan ribbon banner with arched slab-serif text following the curve of the ribbon.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm earth tones?
Does the top text feature decorative spurs?
Is the central portrait framed by a rope texture?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the rope frame is seamless.
Verify the spurred text is legible but decorative.
Check that the leather texture doesn't obscure the border lines.
Confirm the sepia tone is applied to the central photo.
recipe.reuseFormula: Leather texture background + Rope frame + Spurred display type + Arched banner = Western Heritage Aesthetic
